balance.title: Trading account balance
balance.subtitle: The app uses this as a baseline to calculate % risk (lot size, loss limits) for the next steps.
balance.error: Please enter a valid account balance (greater than 0).

quiz.title: Weakness profile
quiz.subtitle: Answer based on your real trading habits — there are no right or wrong answers.
quiz.error: Please answer all questions before continuing.

q1.question: Do you often open a trade against the trend right after being stopped out (SL)?

q2.question: Do you often move your Stop Loss further away when price moves against your expectations?

q3.question: Do you often increase your lot size after a losing trade to "win it back"?

q4.question: Do you often enter right before/during major economic news (NFP, CPI, rate decisions)?

q5.question: Do you often enter trades without a plan (no predefined Entry/SL/TP)?

q6.question: Do you often trade more times in a day than originally planned?

q7.question: Do you often enter with a larger size than your set risk level?

weaknessSummary.title: Your predicted weaknesses
weaknessSummary.subtitle: Based on your answers, these are the weaknesses you recognize that could affect your trading results. The system will track and compare against your real behavior.
weaknessSummary.noWeaknessBody: You didn't recognize any risky habits in the quiz. If your trading results aren't what you expect, follow the Journal — real data gives the most accurate answer.
weaknessSummary.note: Note: this is a prediction based on your answers — once real trade data is available, the system will compare to identify weaknesses more accurately.

explain.title: 2 scores, 2 different meanings
explain.disciplineBody: Measures how well you FOLLOW your own plan: enter trades as planned, don't move SL, no revenge trading...
explain.edgeBody: Measures how effective your STRATEGY is: winrate, risk:reward ratio, total PnL.
explain.note: A high discipline score doesn't guarantee profit — it ensures you identify the right cause of losses: strategy or behavior. You can review this explanation in Settings.

constitution.title: Your trading constitution
constitution.subtitle: These are YOUR rules — the app only helps you keep your promise to yourself, it doesn't impose.
constitution.freeLimitError: Free plan allows up to {{count}} rules. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited.
constitution.missingRequired: You need the 2 required rules: Max risk per trade and Max daily loss.
constitution.tierNote: You're on the Free plan (max 3 rules). Upgrade to Pro for unlimited.

portfolioRisk.title: Portfolio risk
portfolioRisk.subtitle: Accumulated risk of open positions. Threshold = min(rule risk/trade × 3, max daily loss).

portfolioRisk.proGateText: See correlations between your open positions (EURUSD ↔ XAUUSD ↔ USDJPY) to avoid stacking risk in the same direction. Unlock 24h of Pro by watching 1 ad.
portfolioRisk.corrNote: Coefficients are market-convention estimates — not calculated from your real price data. Positive = same direction (stacked risk), negative = offsetting.
portfolioRisk.needTwoSymbols: Need ≥ 2 different symbols to compute correlation.
